INSERT INTO "TelegramUser" (id, "telegramId", username, "firstName", "lastName",
                  language, "isSubscribed", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'en', false, $6, $6)
           ON CONFLICT ("telegramId") DO UPDATE
             SET username = EXCLUDED.username, "firstName" = EXCLUDED."firstName",
                 "lastName" = EXCLUDED."lastName", "updatedAt" = EXCLUDED."updatedAt"
